abilities.name: Air Sphere
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. If Aang is Air-Aligned, this deals 5 additional damage and the next skill they use will be delayed for 1 turn. If used the turn after Water Whip, this will reduce all the target's damage by 20 for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Water Whip
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to the enemy team and reduces their affliction damage by 10 for 2 turns. If Aang is Water-Aligned, this deals 5 additional damage and reduces all damage instead. If used the turn after Earth Pillars, this will stun their Physical, Affliction, and Strategic skills the first turn it deals damage.

abilities.name: Earth Pillars
abilities.description: The next skill one enemy uses will have its damage capped at 10. If Aang is Earth-Aligned, this will cap the damage of the next 2 skills the target uses instead. If used the turn after Fire Kick, this deals 10 affliction damage to the target every turn it is active.

abilities.name: Fire Kick
abilities.description: Deals 40 affliction damage to one enemy. If Aang is Fire-Aligned, this deals 15 additional damage. If used the turn after Air Sphere, the entire enemy team is also dealt 5 affliction damage for 2 turns, Bypassing Invulnerability.

abilities.name: Avatar Cycle
abilities.description: Passive: Whenever Aang uses a skill matching his current elemental alignment, he cycles to the next elemental alignment in the following sequence: Air -> Water -> Earth -> Fire. When he completes the cycle, he gains Aang Avatar State.

abilities.name: Red-Eyed Killer
abilities.description: Marks one enemy for two turns. During this time, One-Cut Killing may be used on them.

abilities.name: One Cut Killing
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. After two turns have passed, the damaged enemy will die. This skill can only target an enemy marked by Red-Eyed Killer.

abilities.name: Little War Horn
abilities.description: For 2 turns, Akame is invulnerable to Physical skills and she may use One Cut Killing on any target.

abilities.name: Rapid Deflection
abilities.description: Akame becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Transmutation Circle
abilities.description: Alphonse gains 1 random energy, permanently swaps this skill to Ground Pillars, and enables the use of Weapon Alchemy and Destruction Alchemy Strike.

abilities.name: Weapon Alchemy
abilities.description: The next time target ally deals new damage, they deal 15 piercing damage to their primary target. Cannot target a currently affected ally.

abilities.name: Destruction Alchemy Strike
abilities.description: Deals 20 affliction damage to one enemy, removes 1 random energy from them, and marks them for 2 turns. Cannot be used on marked targets, and requires Transmutation Circle to be used.

abilities.name: Golem Armor
abilities.description: Passive: Alphonse starts the game with 30 Shield. He can use this skill to refresh the Shield to 30 points and gain 5 permanent damage reduction (stacks).

abilities.name: Ground Pillars
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies and Shatters them until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Bulbasaur
abilities.description: Ash sends out Bulbasaur, activating Leech Seed on a random enemy. While Bulbasaur is active, Pikachu is replaced by Return!, Squirtle is replaced by Pokedex Scan, and Bulbasaur and Charmander are replaced with Bulbasaur's skills.

abilities.name: Charmander
abilities.description: Ash sends out Charmander, activating Flamethrower on a target enemy. While Charmander is active, Pikachu is replaced by Return!, Squirtle is replaced by Pokedex Scan, and Bulbasaur and Charmander are replaced with Charmander's skills.

abilities.name: Squirtle
abilities.description: Ash sends out Squirtle, activating Bubble. While Squirtle is active, Pikachu is replaced by Return!, Squirtle is replaced by Pokedex Scan, and Bulbasaur and Charmander are replaced with Squirtle's skills.

abilities.name: Pikachu
abilities.description: Ash sends out Pikachu, activating Thunderbolt on a target enemy. While Pikachu is active, Pikachu is replaced by Return!, Squirtle is replaced by Pokedex Scan, and Bulbasaur and Charmander are replaced with Pikachu's skills

abilities.name: Leech Seed
abilities.description: Target enemy receives 10 piercing damage each turn for the rest of the game. Each time this skill deals damage, Bulbasaur heals a random damaged ally for 10 health. If no allies are injured, he gains 1 random energy.

abilities.name: Vine Whip
abilities.description: Bulbasaur deals 10 damage to the enemy team for 3 turns. During this time, Bulbasaur can reactivate this skill for 1 random to counter the next harmful skill used by target enemy. This counter effect is invisible.

abilities.name: Flamethrower
abilities.description: Deals 15 affliction damage to target enemy. Each time Charmander uses this skill, it lasts an additional turn and has 1 higher cooldown.

abilities.name: Fire Spin
abilities.description: Target enemy takes 10 affliction damage each turn for 4 turns. During this time, the affected enemy cannot target their allies.

abilities.name: Bubble
abilities.description: Adds 1 stack of Bubble to all enemies. Whenever an enemy uses a new skill, they take 5 piercing damage for each stack of Bubble they have, then lose 1 stack.

abilities.name: Water Gun
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and lowers their non-affliction damage by 5 for 2 turns. If used on an already affected enemy, the target will be stunned for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Thunderbolt
abilities.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to target enemy and paralyzes their cooldowns for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Pokedex Scan
abilities.description: Target enemy's invisible skills become visible for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Return!
abilities.description: Ash's active Pokemon returns, setting his skills to his original skillset and making him invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Demon-Slayer Sword
abilities.description: Asta equips the Demon-Slayer Sword. While equipped, he deals 5 additional damage and enemies damaged by him are permanently marked. If Asta damages a marked enemy while wielding a different sword, he will consume the mark to taunt that enemy for 1 turn. Asta can only have one sword equipped at a time.

abilities.name: Demon-Dweller Sword
abilities.description: Asta equips the Demon-Dweller Sword. While equipped, he heals 10 health whenever Liebe Unite deals damage. If he is at full health when this occurs, he will gain 10 permanent Shield instead (this effect does not stack). Asta can only have one sword equipped at a time.

abilities.name: Demon-Destroyer Sword
abilities.description: Asta equips the Demon-Destroyer Sword. While equipped, he deals 10 additional damage, and takes 10 affliction damage whenever Liebe Unite deals damage. Asta can only have one sword equipped at a time.

abilities.name: Liebe Unite
abilities.description: For the rest of the game, Asta will randomly attack one enemy at the end of the turn, dealing 15 damage and applying any weapon effects from his equipped sword. The first time he falls below 70 health, he will counterattack the first person to target him with a skill every turn, dealing 10 damage. The first time he falls below 40 health, he may equip two swords at once.

abilities.name: Molecule Punch
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Subatomic Explosion
abilities.description: Shatters all enemies and deals 15 damage to them for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Molecule Armor
abilities.description: Eve grants herself or an ally 10 points of Damage Reduction for 3 turns. Swaps to Molecule Helmet.

abilities.name: Molecule Shield
abilities.description: Eve grants her team 20 points of Shield for 1 turn. For each ally that has this Shield completely destroyed, Eve will deal 5 more damage with new skills for 1 turn. Invisible.

abilities.name: Molecule Helmet
abilities.description: Nullifies one enemy's next 40 damage. Until the Nullify is removed, the target is Blinded and Silenced. Swaps to Molecule Armor.

abilities.name: Detonating Touch
abilities.description: Deals 10 energy damage and 10 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if this target uses a new non-strategic skill, they will take 10 affliction damage.

abilities.name: AP Shot
abilities.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy ignoring invulnerability. For 2 turns this enemy is Shattered and ignores Shield effects.

abilities.name: Stun Grenade
abilities.description: Stuns all enemies' Strategic skills for 1 turn. For 1 turn this swaps to Hauser Impact.

abilities.name: Explosive Dash
abilities.description: This skill makes Katsuki Bakugou invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Hauser Impact
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage, 15 piercing damage, and 10 affliction damage to one enemy. All stacks of Nitroglycerin Storage will be reset.

abilities.name: Nitroglycerin Storage
abilities.description: Passive: This skill triggers each time Bakugou uses a new non-Strategic skill. He gains 5 additional damage permanently.

abilities.name: Speed Star
abilities.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one target. The following turn, this skill may be used again for 1 random, dealing the same damage and making Black Star invulnerable for 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill has a 2 turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Black Star Big Wave
abilities.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to one target and stuns them for 1 turn. If Black Star is affected by Speed Star, this ability is Uncounterable.

abilities.name: Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode
abilities.description: For 3 turns, Black Star gains 5 Damage Reduction and Taunts target enemy. This effect Bypasses, and swaps Speed Star and Black Star Big Wave to their alternates.

abilities.name: Tsubaki: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Black Star becomes invulnerable for one turn. If Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode is active, Black Star's skills will Bypass the following turn.

abilities.name: The Unexplored Path
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. Uncounterable. Targets with active Counter effects take an additional 10 damage from this skill. If the target is currently affected by Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode, they take an additional 10 damage from this skill. Both of these effects can activate.

abilities.name: Shadow Star
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. If that enemy is affected by Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode, they take 15 Piercing damage whenever they damage Black Star with a new skill.

abilities.name: Scatter, Senbonzakura
abilities.description: Byakuya deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy each turn for the rest of the game. While active, this skill costs 1 Red energy and can be used to change its target or deal 20 Piercing damage to the currently affected target. Bypasses Invulnerability.

abilities.name: Bakudo #61: Six-Rod Light Restraint
abilities.description: Target enemy is Shattered and Stunned for 2 turns. During this time, this skill is replaced by Hado #4: Pale Lightning.

abilities.name: Senka
abilities.description: Byakuya targets an enemy for 1 turn. If they don't use a new skill during this time, Byakuya will deal 15 Piercing damage to them and permanently lower their damage by 5 at the end of the next turn. This skill is invisible.

abilities.name: Bakudo #81: Airtight
abilities.description: Byakuya becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Bankai: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi
abilities.description: Passive: After using 4 skills Byakuya will release his Bankai, applying Scatter, Senbonzakura to all enemies and making it target all enemies for the rest of the game. During this time, Bakudo #61: Six-Rod Light Restraint is replaced by White Imperial Sword.

abilities.name: Hado #4: Pale Lightning
abilities.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: White Imperial Sword
abilities.description: Deals 90 Piercing damage split between all living enemies. Bypasses invulnerability.

abilities.name: Mother Catastrophe
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy on the following turn. This damage Bypasses and if it hits an invulnerable target, they are stunned for 1 turn. The target of this skill is invisible, and it cannot be used while active.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.description: Diane gains 30 Shield. While the Shield holds, Mother Catastrophe will take 1 more turn to activate and deal 20 more damage. If used while Mother Catastrophe is active, this will extend and boost the active instance.

abilities.name: Queen's Embrace
abilities.description: For 2 turns, all characters gain 15 damage reduction. During this time, this skill is replaced by Ground Gladius.

abilities.name: Diane Dance
abilities.description: Diane becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. For the rest of the game, Queen's Embrace lasts 1 more turn.

abilities.name: Ground Gladius
abilities.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to an enemy affected by Queen's Embrace. Affected enemies receive 5 Bleed damage the following turn.

abilities.name: Destruction Alchemy
abilities.description: Deals 45 Affliction damage to one enemy and caps their health.

abilities.name: Defensive Alchemy
abilities.description: Grants target ally 20 Shield or target enemy 20 Nullify. For 1 turn, Destruction Alchemy costs 2 random energy, but deals 10 less damage.

abilities.name: Battle Alchemy
abilities.description: Grants an ally 10 more non-affliction damage until the end of the turn. Next turn, Defensive Alchemy has no cost, but grants 10 less Shield/Nullify.

abilities.name: Fullmetal Alchemy
abilities.description: Edward becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. After being used, for the next 4 turns this skill can be used to deal 20 piercing damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Free Transmutation
abilities.description: Passive: Whenever Edward uses Defensive Alchemy or Destruction Alchemy while they are improved, he gains 1 random energy, then this effect is disabled for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Reckless Charge
abilities.description: Eren deals 35 damage to one enemy and loses 5 health. This skill will deal 5 additional damage to both Eren and his target each time it's used.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Save
abilities.description: Eren targets one ally, reflecting all harmful skills used on them to himself for 2 turns. This skill is invisible.

abilities.name: Titan Transformation
abilities.description: Eren marks one selected enemy and one random enemy. This skill stacks and cannot be removed. When Eren's health reaches 40 or below all marked enemies will take 10 damage for every stack they have. When triggered, Eren will heal 5 health for each stack of this skill and all of his skills swap to alternates for the rest of the game. This skill is invisible.

abilities.name: Eren Rampage
abilities.description: Eren deals 20 damage to one random enemy and becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill becomes 'Titan Eren Assault' when 'Titan Transformation' activates.

abilities.name: Titan Eren Assault
abilities.description: Titan Eren assaults one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and becoming invulnerable afterwards.

abilities.name: Titan Bite
abilities.description: Deals 65 damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Titan KO
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy and fully stuns them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Titan Heal
abilities.description: Heals Eren Yaeger 30 health.

abilities.name: Bridal Chest
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy, and increases the remaining cooldown of one of their skills by 1.

abilities.name: Bridal Rampage
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. The following 2 turns, Frankenstein will ignore non-damage effects and will use Bridal Chest on a random enemy every turn.

abilities.name: Blasted Tree
abilities.description: Frankenstein self-destructs, dealing damage equal to her missing HP in Piercing damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: Galvanism
abilities.description: For the next 4 turns, Frankenstein will heal 15 HP any time she is affected by a new Energy skill, and Bridal Chest's cooldown increasing effect is increased by 1.

abilities.name: Stoneskin
abilities.description: Target ally gains 15 damage reduction for 4 turns. During this time, Earthen Embrace can be used and Earthen Surge will deal 15 more damage if Stoneskin is on Gaia.

abilities.name: Rampart
abilities.description: Grants all allied heroes 15 shield for 1 turn. If it is not broken, that ally becomes invulnerable for a turn.

abilities.name: Earthen Surge
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. If all allied heroes have Shield, this ability will target all enemies.

abilities.name: Earthen Embrace
abilities.description: Gaia gains 20 shield and stuns one enemy for 3 turns. During this time, they receive 5 more direct damage. This skill will end if Gaia receives new damage. Requires Stoneskin to be active.

abilities.name: Harmonize
abilities.description: Can only target heroes that are currently affected by one of Gaia’s skills. If an ally, they are healed for 15 health. If an enemy, they receive 15 true damage. If Gaia, she gains Elemental Essence.

abilities.name: Gallant Guard
abilities.description: Counters the first Harmful, non-Strategic skill used against one ally for 1 turn. If this skill expires without being triggered, it swaps to Shield of the Just for 1 turn. For 1 turn, Lightning Joust will strike twice.

abilities.name: Lightning Joust
abilities.description: Gallantmon deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shield of the Just will reflect instead of counter. If this skill is countered, it will be replaced by Shield of the Just for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Yuggoth Blaster
abilities.description: Gallantmon deals 25 damage to target enemy and increases the cost of their skills by 1 Random energy for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Grani Flight
abilities.description: Gallantmon becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Shield of the Just
abilities.description: Deals 30 True damage to target enemy. If this skill is replacing Gallant Guard, Gallantmon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If this skill is replacing Lightning Joust, the enemy is also stunned for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Ganta Gun
abilities.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. This deals 5 more damage for each stack of his passive already on him.

abilities.name: Supersonic Ganta Gun
abilities.description: Deals 10 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill deals 5 more damage per 20 health Ganta is missing and 5 more damage per 20 health the target is missing.

abilities.name: Ganbare Gun
abilities.description: Ganta deals 45 damage to one enemy, then 25 damage to all enemies, and then 15 damage to his entire team. This skill is only usable if Ganta is at 10 health or below. This threshold increases by 5 for each stack of his passive that is active on Ganta.

abilities.name: Reckless Rush
abilities.description: For one turn, Ganta receives 5 additional damage from non-Affliction sources. During this time, Ganta cannot die and if an enemy deals new damage to Ganta, Ganta's skills will Bypass Invulnerability and deal 10 additional damage against them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Branch of Sin: Woodpecker
abilities.description: Passive: Whenever Ganta uses a harmful skill, he takes 3 affliction damage per turn for 5 turns.

abilities.name: Lightning Paw
abilities.description: Gatomon deals 15 damage to 1 enemy and Blinds their Helpful skills for 1 turn. Gatomon gains 1 stack of 'Digivolution'.

abilities.name: Cat's Eye
abilities.description: Gatomon deals 20 damage to target enemy and paralyzes their cooldowns for 1 turn. Gatomon gains 1 stack of 'Digivolution'.

abilities.name: Gatomon Digivolve
abilities.description: Gatomon digivolves based on her Digivolution stacks, replacing her skills for the rest of the game. If used with 2 stacks of Digivolution, Gatomon will digivolve into Angewomon. If used with 3 stacks, Gatomon will digivolve into Ophanimon. This skill is usable while stunned.

abilities.name: Nekodamashi
abilities.description: Gatomon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains one stack of Digivolution. This skill shares a cooldown with Angel Wings and Holy Light.

abilities.name: Holy Slap
abilities.description: Angewomon deals 25 damage to 1 enemy and Blinds their Harmful skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Celestial Arrow
abilities.description: Angewomon deals 25 true damage to 1 enemy.

abilities.name: Heaven's Charm
abilities.description: Target ally heals 10 HP and gains 10 Shield and 10 DR for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Angel Wings
abilities.description: Angewomon becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill shares a cooldown with Nekodamashi.

abilities.name: Saint Air
abilities.description: Passive: Angewomon will heal 5 HP every turn.

abilities.name: Eden's Javelin
abilities.description: Ophanimon deals 30 Piercing damage to 1 enemy and fully blinds their skills for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Sefirot Crystal
abilities.description: Ophanimon deals 10 damage 9 times to random enemies. Bypasses Invulnerability.

abilities.name: Final Judgement
abilities.description: Ophanimon deals 30 True damage to the enemy team and fully blinds their skills for 1 turn. If any enemy uses any skills during this time, this effect is extended by 1 turn for the entire enemy team.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Ophanimon becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and removes all harmful skills from her team. This skill shares a cooldown with Nekodamashi.

abilities.name: Eden's Air
abilities.description: Passive: Ophanimon heals 10 HP per turn and gains 10 permanent damage reduction.

abilities.name: Machine-Gun Blows
abilities.description: Deals 5 damage to one enemy twice. The next time this skill is used it will deal Affliction damage instead* then permanently increase this skill's damage by 5 and revert back to Normal damage (stacks).

abilities.name: Lightning Eye
abilities.description: For 1 turn, the enemy team is Shattered, Blinded, and take 5 additional damage from all sources. 'Rocket Boosters' has its cooldown reset and is improved for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Super Incineration Cannon
abilities.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy for 3 turns. Any enemy to use a new Affliction skill on Genos during this time will recieve 10 Affliction damage. While active, this skill swaps to 'Lightning Drill Cannon'.

abilities.name: Rocket Boosters
abilities.description: This skill makes Genos invulnerable for 1 turn. If improved, for 2 turns, this skill will swap to 'Self-Destruct'.

abilities.name: Lightning Drill Cannon
abilities.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy and fully stuns them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Gate of Babylon
abilities.description: If used on Gilgamesh, adds one stack of Gate of Babylon. If used on an enemy, deals 10 damage to that enemy, then consumes all stacks of Gate of Babylon from Gilgamesh to repeat this effect once per stack consumed.

abilities.name: Enkidu, Chains of Heaven
abilities.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a new Harmful skill, they will be countered. Next turn, that enemy's skills and effects do not deal damage or healing. This effect is invisible until triggered.

abilities.name: Enuma Elish
abilities.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy and for 1 turn, that enemy's skills and effects do not deal damage or healing.

abilities.name: Gate of Babylon - Interception
abilities.description: Gilgamesh becomes invulnerable for one turn. This skill requires 1 stack of Gate of Babylon to be used, and consumes that stack on use.

abilities.name: Kamehameha
abilities.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, this skill costs 1 blue energy and deals 15 less damage, then resets back to its original cost and damage.

abilities.name: Kaioken x20
abilities.description: Goku gains 10 points of damage reduction and takes 5 affliction damage every turn for 3 turns. While active, this swaps to Kaioken Rush and Kamehameha deals 10 additional damage, becomes piercing, and deals 5 affliction damage to Goku.

abilities.name: Spirit Bomb
abilities.description: Deals 60 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns them for 1 turn. Each time Goku uses the reduced cost version of Kamehameha, this skill costs 1 less Blue energy until the next time it's used. Bypassing.

abilities.name: Instant Transmission
abilities.description: Goku becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Kaioken Rush
abilities.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and 10 affliction damage to himself.

abilities.name: Jajanken Stance
abilities.description: Gon gains 10 Shield and his skills will deal 10 more damage permanently and are improved. This skill stacks & will end if Gon uses a Damaging Skill.

abilities.name: Jajanken Rock
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy. This skill will stun if Gon has 'Jajanken Stance' active.

abilities.name: Jajanken Paper
abilities.description: Deals 10 Damage to the enemy team. This skill will instead cost 1 Random, become piercing, and Blind its targets if 'Jajanken Stance' is active.

abilities.name: Jajanken Scissors
abilities.description: Gon Freecss executes an enemy at 25HP or below. If Gon has stacks of Jajanken Stance, this skill will first deal 10 damage for every stack of 'Jajanken Stance' Gon has.

abilities.name: Ice, Make...
abilities.description: Until the end of his next turn, Gray ignores stun effects and can use his skills. During this time, this skill is replaced by Ice, Make Unlimited. If Ice, Make Unlimited is already active, this skill is replaced by One-Sided Chaotic Dance.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Freeze Lancer
abilities.description: Gray deals 15 piercing damage to the enemy team for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Hammer
abilities.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Shield
abilities.description: Gray becomes invulnerable for one turn.

abilities.name: Disciple of Ur
abilities.description: The first time Gray's health reaches 30 or below, he will permanently gain the effects of Ice, Make... and Ice, Make Shield will be replaced by Iced Shell.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Unlimited
abilities.description: For the rest of the game, Gray's team gains 5 Shield each turn, and the enemy team receives 5 piercing damage each turn.

abilities.name: Iced Shell
abilities.description: Target enemy is permanently stunned and will take 10 true damage each turn. After applying this effect, Gray dies. This skill cannot be countered or reflected, and this death cannot be prevented with effects.

abilities.name: One-Sided Chaotic Dance
abilities.description: Deals 5 piercing damage to one enemy, increased by 10 for each time Ice, Make... has been used during the battle.

abilities.name: Deep Forest Bloom: Pollen
abilities.description: Hashirama heals his team for 10 HP and deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy team. This skill is delayed by 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill will heal Hashirama's team for 5 HP and deal 5 Affliction damage to the enemy team each turn that it remains delayed.

abilities.name: Deep Forest Bloom: Strangle
abilities.description: Target enemy takes 10 damage and is stunned for 1 turn. This skill is always delayed by 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill will stun a random targetable enemy's Physical and Energy skills each turn that it remains delayed.

abilities.name: Deep Forest Creation
abilities.description: For the next 3 turns, Deep Forest Bloom: Pollen and Deep Forest Bloom: Strangle are enhanced and delayed for 1 more turn. While active, this skill can be reactivated to extend the duration on all active delay effects by 1 turn.

abilities.name: Wood Clone
abilities.description: For one turn, the first Harmful skill that targets Hashirama or one ally will be delayed for 2 turns. Invisible until triggered.

abilities.name: Great Thriving Forest
abilities.description: Passive: At the end of each of his turns, Hashirama will give his team 5 Shield and deal 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team for each of Hashirama's currently delayed skills.

abilities.name: Zangetsu Slash
abilities.description: Ichigo deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 5 additional damage every time it is used.

abilities.name: Getsuga Tenshou
abilities.description: Ichigo deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Ichigo becomes invulnerable to non-Strategic skills and gains 1 random energy. This skill will deal 5 additional damage for each time 'Hollow Slayer' and 'Getsuga Tenshou' were used.

abilities.name: Bankai: Tensa Zangetsu
abilities.description: Each time Ichigo uses a skill, he permanently deals 5 more damage (stacking).

abilities.name: Ichigo Block
abilities.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Invincible Punch
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Heroic Rush
abilities.description: Mark makes himself or one ally invulnerable for 1 turn. If he chooses himself, Invincible Punch deals 15 additional damage for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Desperate Bite
abilities.description: Deals 10 true damage to one enemy. Swaps to Face Smash.

abilities.name: Viltrumite Flight
abilities.description: Mark becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Face Smash
abilities.description: Deals 15 true damage to one enemy and permanently increases the non-Affliction damage they take by 5 (stacks). Swaps to Desperate Bite.

abilities.name: A Reason To Fight
abilities.description: Every time one of Mark's allies takes new damage, he permanently deals 5 more damage (stacks).

abilities.name: Maria The Ripper
abilities.description: Jack deals 10 normal damage and 10 affliction damage to one enemy. Can only target Isolated enemies or enemies affected by Fog of London.

abilities.name: Fog of London
abilities.description: Jack deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, they will receive 50% reduced healing. This skill cannot be countered.

abilities.name: We Are Jack
abilities.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to target Isolated enemy that is also affected by Fog of London.

abilities.name: Smokescreen Ambush
abilities.description: Jack deals 15 damage to target enemy and becomes Invulnerable for one turn. If this targets an Isolated enemy or an enemy affected by Fog of London, its cooldown is reduced by 2. Both of these effects can occur.

abilities.name: Streets of the Lost
abilities.description: Passive: At the end of any turn in which an enemy is the only character to act, or is the only character to not act, that enemy is Isolated for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Lightning Blade Kunai
abilities.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Long-Range Kamui
abilities.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 random energy from them. Until they use a new skill, the next skill the target uses will deal 100% less damage (invisible).

abilities.name: Lightning Release: Shadow Clone
abilities.description: Kakashi targets himself or a selected ally for 1 turn. The next harmful skill is used on him will be countered and the countered enemy will take 25 piercing damage. Invisible.

abilities.name: Kamui Squad Ambush
abilities.description: This skill makes this character and a selected ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Copy Ninja Kakashi
abilities.description: Passive: Kakashi's skills cannot be countered or reflected.

abilities.name: Tentacle Pierce
abilities.description: Kaneki deals 5 bleed damage to one enemy next turn. This skill deals 5 additional damage every time it is used.

abilities.name: Disembowel
abilities.description: Kaneki deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and any bleed currently active on them becomes permanent.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Rampage
abilities.description: Kaneki ignores Harmful, non-damaging effects for 3 turns. During this time, Kaneki will use Tentacle Pierce on any enemy that uses a new harmful skill on him.

abilities.name: Tentacle Block
abilities.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Claws Assassination
abilities.description: Killua deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy and gives them one stack of Decapitation. The following 2 turns, this skill and Heart Ripper will deal 10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Heart Ripper
abilities.description: Killua deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy, stuns them for 1 turn, and gives them 1 stack of Decapitation.

abilities.name: Decapitation
abilities.description: Killua detonates all Decapitation Counters on an enemy, dealing 15 affliction damage for each counter detonated. Affected enemies are Executed if their health falls to 20 or below.

abilities.name: Killua Hide
abilities.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Chastifold: Sunflower
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy not currently affected by Disaster. When Empowered, deals 35 damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: Chastifold: Increase
abilities.description: Deals 5 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. When Empowered, this damage increases to 10 Piercing damage.

abilities.name: True Spirit Spear Chastifold
abilities.description: For 4 turns, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on King or his allies will be affected by Disaster. During this time, his skills are Empowered and this skill is replaced by Chastifold: Pollen Garden.

abilities.name: Chastifold: Guardian
abilities.description: Target allied character gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. When Empowered, Reflects the next Harmful skill received for 1 turn (Invisible)

abilities.name: Chastifold: Pollen Garden
abilities.description: For 2 turns, if King's allies do not act, they will become Invulnerable and heal 15 HP for the remainder of this skill's duration.

abilities.name: Disaster
abilities.description: Any enemy that receives non-Bleed damage from King will take 10 Bleed damage next turn. This will not occur if the initial damage is absorbed or prevented.

abilities.name: Hard Lessons
abilities.description: For the next 4 turns, Koro-sensei will make all characters Invulnerable to one of the following classes of skills for 1 turn, chosen at random: Physical, Mental, Energy, Affliction. Each turn the chosen class will change to a random choice of the classes that haven't been chosen yet.

abilities.name: Impossible Speed
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If used during Hard Lessons, this skill will activate Class Is In Session on a random ally with a random instance of its normal effects.

abilities.name: Protective Molting
abilities.description: Koro-Sensei targets another ally for 1 turn. During this time, if they receive a new Harmful skill, they will have all enemy effects removed from them and heal 25 HP. The turn after this effect is triggered, Pitch Black has no cost.

abilities.name: Pitch Black
abilities.description: For the next 4 turns, Impossible Speed Bypasses and will mark its target for the remainder of Pitch Black's duration. During this time, whenever Impossible Speed is used, Koro-Sensei will also use it on any marked target.

abilities.name: Class Is In Session!
abilities.description: Passive: Whenever any other character ends their turn without using a new skill, they will gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. Whenever any other character is stunned, they will heal 10 HP.

abilities.name: Fire Control
abilities.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Affliction skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Fire Fist'. Invisible.

abilities.name: Air Control
abilities.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Mental skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Air Wave'. Invisible.

abilities.name: Earth Control
abilities.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Physical skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Earth Area Attack'. Invisible.

abilities.name: Water Control
abilities.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Energy skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Water Arm Stun'. Invisible.

abilities.name: Fire Fist
abilities.description: Deals 25 Affliction damage to one enemy and increases the Affliction damage they take by 10 for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Air Wave
abilities.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to all enemies and increases the cost of their skills by 1 random energy for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Earth Area Attack
abilities.description: Destroys all enemy Shield then deals 40 damage to one enemy and 20 to all others.

abilities.name: Water Arm Stun
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy and stuns their non-Mental skills for 2 turns. Cannot be used while active.

abilities.name: Energybending
abilities.description: Korra targets an ally or an enemy. If an ally, they will permanently ignore enemy non-damage effects and if an enemy they are permanently silenced. Cannot be used on an affected character and cannot be removed.

abilities.name: Gate Open
abilities.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to the enemy team and for 2 turns the next skill they use will be delayed for 8 turns.

abilities.name: Korra Avatar State
abilities.description: Passive: If Korra uses a skill from the same element 5 times she will activate the avatar state for 4 turns: If Fire: Deals 10 affliction damage to any enemy that uses a new skill on her, If Earth: Grants 40 permanent Shield, If Water: gives 20 damage reduction, If Air: makes Korra ignore all non-damage harmful effects. While active, Earth Control and Water Control swap to 'Energybending' and 'Gate Open'. This can only occur once per game.

abilities.name: Bokken Smash
abilities.description: Destroys all of one enemy's Shield and deals 30 damage to them.

abilities.name: Chain Jail
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy, stuns their non-Mental skills and marks them for 1 turn. Swaps to Judgement Chain for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Holy Chain
abilities.description: Removes all enemy harmful effects from Kurapika or an ally and heals them 35HP.

abilities.name: Scarlet Eyes
abilities.description: Kurapika will ignore the next new enemy damage he receives. Invisible. While active, this skill cannot be used and Bokken Smash deals 10 more damage.

abilities.name: Judgement Chain
abilities.description: The enemy marked by 'Chain Jail' is targeted until Kurapika dies. If they use 3 new skills, they will be instantly killed. While active, every turn the target does not use a new skill, they will take 10 affliction damage and lose 1 energy. May not be used while active. Unremovable.

abilities.name: Judgement Throw
abilities.description: Kuroko deals 20 damage to one enemy and Silences them for one turn. If used on the turn after Teleporting Strike, this skill will stun its target for 1 turn. If used on the turn after Needle Pin, this skill will remove one energy from its target.

abilities.name: Teleporting Strike
abilities.description: Kuroko deals 15 damage to one enemy and becomes invulnerable for one turn. If used on the turn after Needle Pin, this ability will have no cooldown. If used on the turn after Judgement Throw, this ability will deal 15 extra damage.

abilities.name: Needle Pin
abilities.description: One enemy becomes Shattered for two turns. If used on the turn after Teleporting Strike, this skill Bypasses and deals 20 piercing damage to its target. If used on the turn after Judgement Throw, this skill will Isolate its target for one turn.

abilities.name: Tactical Teleport
abilities.description: Kuroko becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Transform: Liz
abilities.description: Target ally wields Liz for 3 turns. The Thompson Sisters gain 10 Damage Reduction, and if the targeted ally uses a new Harmful skill, the Thompson Sisters will deal 10 damage to their primary target. Allies wielding Liz have their Green costs changed to Random. Allies wielding Patty have their Blue costs changed to Random.

abilities.name: Transform: Patty
abilities.description: Target ally wields Patty for 3 turns. The Thompson Sisters gain 10 Damage Reduction, and if the targeted ally uses a new Harmful skill, the Thompson Sisters will deal 10 damage to their primary target. Allies wielding Patty have their Blue costs changed to Random.

abilities.name: Thompson Sisters Soul Resonance
abilities.description: Until the end of the turn, if target ally uses a new Strategic skill, they will become Immortal for 2 turns. Liz: if they use a new Helpful skill, their targets will heal 10 HP each turn for 2 turns. Patty: if they use a new Harmful skill, their next skill will deal 15 more non-Affliction damage.

abilities.name: Coordinated Evasion
abilities.description: The Thompson Sisters become Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Wavelength Compression: Patty
abilities.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and heals the ally wielding Patty for 10 HP. Can only be used if Patty is currently being wielded.

abilities.name: Wavelength Compression: Liz
abilities.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and gives the ally wielding Liz 10 Shield. Can only be used if Liz is currently being wielded.

abilities.name: Brooklyn Devils
abilities.description: The Thompson Sisters alternate between two forms: Liz and Patty. When any ally begins wielding Liz or Patty, the other becomes active. Liz is the active sister at the start of the battle.

abilities.name: Aquarius
abilities.description: Lucy deals 15 damage to all enemies and grants her team 10 points of damage reduction for one turn.

abilities.name: Urano Metria

abilities.name: Gomu Gomu No Pistol

abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies, Bypassing Invulnerability. This skill deals 5 more damage every time it is used (stacks) and lasts 1 more turn if used on an enemy who is Invulnerable.

abilities.name: Maneuvering Gear
abilities.description: Mikasa and a selected ally ignore Harmful, non-damage effects for 1 turn. Swaps to 'Thunder Spear' while active. This effect is invisible.

abilities.name: Unlikely Savior
abilities.description: Mikasa becomes invulnerable and stuns target enemy's non-Strategic skills until the end of Mikasa's next turn.

abilities.name: Electric Deflection
abilities.description: Misaka becomes invulnerable for one turn.

abilities.name: Ultra Railgun
abilities.description: Misaka deals 40 damage to target enemy. This ability Bypasses Invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected. Using this ability will reset all her abilities to their original forms and prevent her from switching for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Grisly Wing

abilities.name: Demonic Frenzy

abilities.name: Pyrokinesis

abilities.name: Little Nezuko!

abilities.name: Perfect Stance
abilities.description: For 1 turn, Oetsu ignores all harmful effects. Invisible.

abilities.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.description: Rimuru marks an enemy for 1 turn. If they use a new skill, it will be copied and the target will have their cooldowns paralyzed for 2 turns. Invisible. Swaps to 'Beezlebuth' during 'Passive: Demon Lord Awakening'.

abilities.name: Megiddo
abilities.description: Rimuru deals 25 Affliction damage to the enemy team and 5 Affliction damage permanently, then swaps Rimuru's first 3 skills to their alternate versions. Unremovable.

abilities.name: Slime Transformation
abilities.description: Rimuru ignores harmful non-damage effects and heals 15 health for 2 turns. While active, this swaps to 'Demon Summon' and it is the only skill that may be used.

abilities.name: Current
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to the enemy team and places an invisible stack of Current on the primary target. Gain Elemental Essence.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. If they are affected by Current, they are stunned for 1 turn and a stack of Current is consumed.

abilities.name: Ripple
abilities.description: River Daughter deals 10 damage to the enemy team. For 1 turn, Undertow will target all enemies.

abilities.name: Dive
abilities.description: For 1 turn, River Daughter will ignore all damaging effects. The following turn, Ripple will have double duration.

abilities.name: River Clone
abilities.description: Counters the first harmful skill used by target enemy for 1 turn and gives them a stack of Current. If the enemy is countered this way, they gain another stack of Current.

abilities.name: In the Name of Ruler!
abilities.description: Ruler stuns one enemy and herself for 2 turns. This skill cannot be used while active and will have its cooldown increased by 1 each time it is used.

abilities.name: Minion - Minael and Yunael
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy or gives 20 destructible defense to Ruler.

abilities.name: Minion - Tama
abilities.description: The next time target ally receives a new harmful ability, that ability is countered and its user takes 35 piercing damage. This effect can only be active on one target at a time and is invisible until triggered.

abilities.name: Minion - Swim Swim
abilities.description: Ruler becomes invulnerable for one turn.

abilities.name: Maximum Cannon
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. This skill deals 15 additional damage and costs 1 additional random for every stack of To the Extreme!!, consuming all stacks on use.

abilities.name: Kangaryu
abilities.description: Heals your entire team for 10. This skill lasts 1 additional turn and costs 1 additional random for every stack of To the Extreme!!, consuming all stacks on use.

abilities.name: Vongola Headgear
abilities.description: For 3 turns, Ryohei will ignore harmful stun effects and changes to his ability costs. During this time, Maximum Cannon becomes piercing and Kangaryu also grants 10 damage reduction every turn it is active.

abilities.name: To the Extreme!!
abilities.description: For the rest of the game, whenever Ryohei receives 20 total damage, he gains a stack of To The Extreme!!, empowering his abilities.

abilities.name: Fiber Lost
abilities.description: Ryuko deals 20 damage to one enemy and caps their damage at 20 for one turn. If this skill kills an enemy, Ryuko will heal 10 health and permanently deal 10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Decapitation Mode
abilities.description: Fiber Lost and Life Fiber Synchronization will target all valid characters, but will cost 1 additional random energy. This skill may be used while active to toggle the effect off.

abilities.name: Life Fiber Synchronization
abilities.description: For the next 2 turns, whenever an ally receives new damage, they will heal for that amount over the next 2 turns.

abilities.name: Ryuko Block
abilities.description: Ryuko becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Excalibur
abilities.description: Saber deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy and Silences them for one turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and starts the game on cooldown.

abilities.name: Wind Blade Combat
abilities.description: Saber deals 20 damage to one enemy and ignores stun effects for one turn. If used while costing Green energy, for 1 turn this skill will cost 1 Random energy. If used while costing random energy, for 1 turn this skill will cost nothing. This skill cannot be countered.

abilities.name: Avalon
abilities.description: One ally permanently heals 10 health per turn. Once active, Saber can reactivate this skill to reflect all new harmful effects received by that ally to herself for one turn.

abilities.name: Providence
abilities.description: Saber or the target of her Avalon become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill always costs the same energy as Wind Blade Combat.

abilities.name: Normal Punch
abilities.description: Destroys one enemy's Shield then deals 45 damage to them. Swaps with 'Consecutive Normal Punches' at the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Consecutive Normal Punches
abilities.description: Destroys the enemy team's Shield and deals 30 damage to them. Swaps with with 'Normal Punch' at the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Serious Series: Serious Table-Flip
abilities.description: Saitama removes all harmful skills from his team. For 1 turn, Saitama's team becomes Invulnerable and for 2 turns the enemy team becomes Shattered. Swaps to 'Serious Series: Omni-Directional Serious Punch' permanently.

abilities.name: Serious Series: Serious Side-Hops
abilities.description: For 1 turn, the first non-strategic enemy harmful skill used on Saitama will be countered. If successful, Saitama gains 1 green energy, the enemy is marked, and this swaps to 'Serious Series: Serious Punch' for 1 turn. Invisible.

abilities.name: Serious Series: Serious Punch
abilities.description: The enemy marked by 'Serious Series: Serious Side-Hops' is instantly killed. Uncounterable, unreflectable.

abilities.name: Cherry Blossom Fist
abilities.description: Sakura targets an enemy for 1 turn, counters them if they use a new harmful skill, and gains 1 random energy if successful. Swaps to 'Kunai Stabbing' for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Medical Ninjutsu
abilities.description: Sakura gains 15 points of Damage Reduction and ignores enemy stun effects for 3 turns. While this is active, this swaps to 'Mind Strangle'.

abilities.name: Rampage Gloves
abilities.description: Sakura permanently marks herself or an ally. The first enemy to use a new harmful skill on them will receive 25 damage and be stunned for 1 turn. Invisible until triggered, and swaps to Kunai Stabbing for 1 turn on use.

abilities.name: Sakura Dodge
abilities.description: Sakura becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and swaps this skill to Kunai Stabbing for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Cherry Blossom Crash
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy and stuns their physical, mental, and strategic skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Shuriken Jutsu
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Until that enemy dies, they take 5 damage each turn and this skill is replaced by Shadow Shuriken Wire Trap.

abilities.name: Chidori Nagashi
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies and removes all Bleed and Affliction damage over time effects from Sasuke.

abilities.name: Great Dragon Fire
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy and marks them for 3 turns. On the second turn, this skill will be replaced by Kirin.

abilities.name: Stalemate
abilities.description: Sasuke becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Shadow Shuriken Wire Trap
abilities.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they will take 15 damage and be stunned for 1 turn. Invisible.

abilities.name: Kirin
abilities.description: Deals 50 damage to target enemy marked by Great Dragon Fire. If that target falls to 10 or less HP, they will be executed. This skill cannot be countered and can only be used once.

abilities.name: Effortless Precision
abilities.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy. If Satsuki is at full health, this ability deals 10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Power
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. If Satsuki is at full health, the target's Harmful skills are stunned for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Perfect Crescent
abilities.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. If Satsuki is at full health, this skill Bypasses and deals 15 more damage.

abilities.name: Disdainful Block
abilities.description: Satsuki becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If Satsuki is at full health, this skill has a 2 turn reduced cooldown.

abilities.name: Flawless Restoration
abilities.description: Satsuki receives 5 more healing from all sources. Additionally, Satsuki heals herself for 0 HP each turn.

abilities.name: Hero Slash
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy and heals Sayaka for 10 HP. This skill will deal 5 additional damage for each 20HP healed by Sayaka's abilities.

abilities.name: Azure Healing
abilities.description: Sayaka heals an ally for 10 health for 5 turns.

abilities.name: Hero Counter
abilities.description: For one turn, if target enemy uses a new damaging ability, it will heal instead of dealing damage. Invisible.

abilities.name: Enraged Slash
abilities.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot deal less than 20 damage. Uncounterable, Bypassing. Grants Sayaka one stack of Soul Gem: Sayaka.

abilities.name: Soul Gem: Sayaka
abilities.description: Passive: Sayaka gains 1 stack of this skill each turn. While Sayaka has at least 6 stacks, she heals 5 health per turn per 20 health she is missing. Sayaka ignores effects that prevent her healing. If Sayaka reaches 12 stacks of this effect, she instantly dies.

abilities.name: Chains of the First Poisoner
abilities.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their Helpful and Strategic skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Mystical Beast - Hydra
abilities.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Affected enemies can remove this effect by ending their turn while Invulnerable, and if it expires normally, the target is stunned for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Arrogant King's Poison
abilities.description: Semiramis deals 5 permanent Affliction damage to all enemies. Upon use, all active enemy Shield, Invulnerability, or heal-over-time effects are converted into additional stacks of 5 permanent Affliction damage. This skill Bypasses.

abilities.name: Scales of the Sacred Fish
abilities.description: Semiramis becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Hanging Gardens of Babylon
abilities.description: Semiramis begins the game banished for 2 turns. She returns to the game with 25 permanent Shield, and gains 1 random energy.

abilities.name: Extase - Bisector of Creation
abilities.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy has Shield, this skill deals 10 more damage. If that enemy has Damage Reduction, this skill deals 5 more damage. Both of these effects can activate.

abilities.name: Savior Strike
abilities.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy and ends all of that enemy's cancellable effects.

abilities.name: Trump Card - Blinding Light
abilities.description: For 2 turns, all enemies are Shattered. During this time, neither of Sheele's allies can be killed.

abilities.name: Extase Block
abilities.description: Sheele becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Ignition: Shinra
abilities.description: For one turn, Shinra's damaging skills will cost one less Green energy and apply 5 permanent affliction damage.

abilities.name: Rapid Kick
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Tora Hishigi
abilities.description: Deals 40 damage to one enemy and stuns them for one turn.

abilities.name: Adolla Burst
abilities.description: Shinra becomes invulnerable for one turn.

abilities.name: Hysterical Strength
abilities.description: Passive: When Shinra falls to 40 health for the first time each game, he will permanently become Isolated and Ignition: Shinra will be reapplied to Shinra each time he uses a new Harmful skill.

abilities.name: Shiro Kick
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will also stun their target's non-strategic skills for 1 turn and deal 10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Mascot Rush
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will also Silence the target for 1 turn and deal 10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Shiro Rampage
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will make her ignore stun and silence effects for 2 turns and deal 10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Ganta Fight Song
abilities.description: Shiro permanently taunts the enemy team. During this time, Shiro takes 5 additional damage from new skills and she gains one stack of Ganta Fever each turn this skill remains active. Channeled.

abilities.name: Ganta Fever
abilities.description: Passive: Whenever Shiro uses a damaging skill, she will consume one stack of Ganta Fever to extend that skill's improvement effect for two turns.

abilities.name: Enhanced Strength
abilities.description: Snow White deals 20 damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Hear Distress
abilities.description: Snow White targets an ally or an enemy for 1 turn. If used on an ally, that ally will gain 25 points of damage reduction and will gain one random energy if a new harmful ability is used on them. If used on an enemy, that enemy will have their first new harmful ability countered, and they will lose one random energy. This skill is invisible until triggered and ignores invulnerability and isolation.

abilities.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
abilities.description: Snow White targets an ally other than herself. For 1 turn, if that ally dies, they instead return to 50 health. This healing cannot be prevented. This effect will not trigger on abilities that kill the user.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Snow White becomes invulnerable for one turn.

abilities.name: Scythe Transformation
abilities.description: For 3 turns, target ally wields Soul. During this time, Soul gains 10 Damage Reduction, and the targeted ally deals 5 more non-Affliction damage and has their Red costs changed to Random costs.

abilities.name: Nightmare Wavelength
abilities.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy and Soul. If an ally is wielding Soul, the damage is split between them.

abilities.name: Nightmare Sonata
abilities.description: For 3 turns, enemies have their strategic skills delayed for 1 turn and Nightmare Wavelength deals 20 more damage.

abilities.name: Consume Soul
abilities.description: Soul heals 50 health and permanently increases the bonus damage effect from Scythe Transformation by 5. Soul must deal 100 damage before each use of this skill.

abilities.name: Partner: Maka
abilities.description: Passive: If Maka is alive on Soul's team, Scythe Transformation can only target her and he will begin the game with Maka wielding him.

abilities.name: Skull Bash
abilities.description: Squirtle deals 20 damage to one enemy. 'Squirtle's Withdraw' has it's cooldown reduced by 1 turn.

abilities.name: Water Gun
abilities.description: Squirtle deals 20 damage to one enemy and makes them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill may not be used during 'Withdraw'. This skill's non-damage effect lasts 1 additional turn for every turn it is used consecutively on the same enemy (stacks).

abilities.name: Bubblebeam
abilities.description: For 3 turns, Squirtle targets all enemies and deals 5 piercing damage and 5 piercing to any enemy that uses a new skill each turn.

abilities.name: Withdraw
abilities.description: Squirtle ends any active skill he has on the enemy team and ignores damaging effects for 2 turns. While active, 'Skull Bash' and 'Bubble Beam' become alternates.

abilities.name: Rapid Spin
abilities.description: Squirtle deals 25 damage to all enemies and ignores enemy stun effects for 1 turn. For 1 turn, 'Hydro Pump' costs 1 less random energy and deals 5 less damage for it's duration.

abilities.name: Hydro Pump
abilities.description: Squirtle deals 15 piercing damage to all enemies for 2 turns. For 1 turn, 'Rapid Spin' costs 1 less random energy and deals 5 less damage.

abilities.name: Thug Life
abilities.description: Squirtle's skills have their damage increased by 5 as long as he consecutively casts a new skill on an enemy each turn. The increased damage only applies to a skill the turn it is cast.

abilities.name: Nekomata Blaze
abilities.description: Tamaki deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for every damage over time effect on them. If the target is affected by Nekomata Cage, this skill Bypasses Invulnerability. Afterwards, causes the enemy to take 5 affliction damage permanently, stacking.

abilities.name: Nekomata Cage
abilities.description: Tamaki targets one enemy for three turns. During this time, if they use a new harmful skill they will receive 5 affliction damage per turn for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Ignition: Nekomata
abilities.description: Tamaki gains 15 permanent Shield and for the next 3 turns, she will ignore enemy non-damage effects and Nekomata Cage will target all enemies. This skill becomes Nekomata Fireball while active.

abilities.name: Fearless Defender
abilities.description: Tamaki gains 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn, and reflects all Harmful skills used on target ally to herself.

abilities.name: Nekomata Fireball
abilities.description: Tamaki deals 30 affliction damage to one target, increased by 5 for every damage over time effect on them. If the target is affected by Nekomata Cage, this skill ignores invulnerability. Afterwards, applies three stacks of 5 permanent affliction damage to the enemy.

abilities.name: Fourth Form: Striking Tide
abilities.description: Tanjiro deals 20 piercing damage to an enemy. Swaps with 'Tenth Form: Constant Flux'.

abilities.name: Third Form: Flowing Dance
abilities.description: Tanjiro deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, increased by 1 turn more whenever Tanjiro uses another skill during this skill. During this time, Tanjiro gains 10 points of damage reduction. This skill cannot be used while it is active and swaps with Sxith Form: Whirlpool.

abilities.name: Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust
abilities.description: For 1 turn, Tanjiro targets his team and counters the first Harmful non-Strategic skill used on them. Countered enemies will take 5 more damage from Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin, and it will deal piercing damage to them. This skill is invisible and swaps with Eight Form: Waterfall Basin.

abilities.name: Second Form: Water Wheel
abilities.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Tenth Form: Constant Flux
abilities.description: Tanjiro deals 30 damage to all enemies. This skill will deal 20 additional damage for each dead enemy.

abilities.name: Sixth Form: Whirlpool
abilities.description: For 2 turns, Tanjiro deals 10 damage to all enemies while making his team invulnerable against Energy skills. Swaps with Third Form: Flowing Dance.

abilities.name: Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin
abilities.description: Tanjiro deals 30 damage to all enemies. Swaps with Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust.

abilities.name: Enhanced Smell
abilities.description: Passive: At the end of each turn, Tanjiro's first three skills may change to their alternate versions.

abilities.name: Psychic Shear
abilities.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their Harmful skills until the end of Tatsumaki's next turn.

abilities.name: Psychokinetic Bind
abilities.description: Applies 20 Nullify to one enemy. If Nullify from Psychokinetic Bind exists on a different enemy, Tatsumaki will slam them together. If there is an enemy between them, this deals damage to them equal to their total Nullify and stuns the enemy for 2 turns. If not, their total Nullify is split between affected enemies and they are both stunned for 1 turn. This removes all Nullify from affected targets and bypasses invulnerability.

abilities.name: Extreme Psychic Twisting
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to all enemies. Stunned enemies have the duration of their stun effects increased by 1 turn. Swaps to Spear of Green Light for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Tatsumaki Barrier
abilities.description: Tatsumaki becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Swaps with City-Wide Barrier for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Spear of Green Light
abilities.description: Targets a currently stunned character, dealing 75 damage to them.

abilities.name: City-Wide Barrier
abilities.description: Tatsumaki's team becomes invulnerable for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Killing Strike
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. If that enemy is stunned, they take 5 additional damage. If the target is below 50 health, they take 5 additional damage. Both of these effects can activate.

abilities.name: Incursio
abilities.description: For 3 turns, Tatsumi gains 10 points of Damage Reduction and becomes Invulnerable at the end of any turn where he doesn't use a new skill. During this time, Neuntote is usable, Killing Strike becomes Piercing damage and Tatsumi's skills will Bypass while he is Invulnerable.

abilities.name: Neuntote
abilities.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy, marking them permanently. Skills and effects will consider the marked enemy to be stunned.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Tatsumi becomes invunerable for 1 turn. Can only be used if Tatsumi is invunerable through Incursio's effect.

abilities.name: Thirsting Knife
abilities.description: Toga deals 15 piercing damage to target enemy and gains one stack of Twisted Love.

abilities.name: Vacuum Syringe
abilities.description: Toga deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy for three turns, gaining one stack of Twisted Love each turn.

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities.description: Toga deals 30 Piercing damage to one enemy and becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Twisted Love
abilities.description: For the next 4 turns, if Toga has 2 or more Twisted Love stacks, Killing Spree deals 15 more damage. If she has 4 or more Twisted Love stacks, her skills cost 1 less Random energy. If she has 6 or more, Twisted Love is replaced by Drop Dead for the duration.

abilities.name: Quirk: Transform
abilities.description: Passive: Toga starts the game disguised as another character (showing their face picture). This effect will end if she takes damage or uses a skill other than Thirsting Knife.

abilities.name: Drop Dead
abilities.description: Toga stuns all enemies for 1 turn. On the following turn, they take 25 damage.

abilities.name: Ukaku Slam
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Deals 5 additional damage to an enemy affected by 'Crystallized Shards'. This skill deals 20 additional damage and fully stuns for 1 turn during 'Crystallized Ukaku'.

abilities.name: Crystallized Shards
abilities.description: Touka deals 5 piercing damage to all enemies and increases their cooldowns by 1 for 2 turns. This deals 15 additional damage during 'Crystallized Ukaku'.

abilities.name: Crystallized Ukaku
abilities.description: Touka gains 20 Shield, makes her skills single-target, and deals 5 damage to all enemies every turn for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Touka Observation
abilities.description: Touka becomes invulnerable and increases her damage by 5 for 1 turn.

abilities.name: X-Burner
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy, and 10 damage to the others.

abilities.name: Zero Point Breakthrough
abilities.description: For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new Affliction or Energy skill on Tsuna is countered and stunned for 1 turn. If this move successfully counters an ability, X-Burner will deal 10 additional damage to all targets for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Burning Axle
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy, marking them permanently. If that enemy is damaged by X-Burner, they take 10 damage and are stunned for 1 turn, consuming the mark.

abilities.name: Flare Burst
abilities.description: Tsuna becomes invulnerable for 1 turn

abilities.name: BindBenihime
abilities.description: Fully stuns one enemy, makes them unable to become invulnerable, and ignore healing effects for 1 turn. The following turn, this swaps to 'Fire-Play, Benihime'.

abilities.name: Seal Slaying Penance
abilities.description: One enemy has their non-affliction damage lowered by 10 until they use a new non-strategic skill. The next time that enemy uses a new non-strategic skill, they will receive 20 damage. This effect stacks and is invisible.

abilities.name: Suspended Seal Destruction
abilities.description: Fully stuns an enemy for 1 turn then removes 1 random energy and their helpful effects from them. If their health is at 50 or less, this stuns for 2 turns and removes 2 random energies instead.

abilities.name: Negation Block
abilities.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Fire-Play, Benihime
abilities.description: Deals 40 affliction damage to the enemy affected by 'Bind, Benihime'.

abilities.name: Zero Gravity
abilities.description: Marks one enemy. The next skill they use will have its damage reduced by 10 and will remove 1 random energy from them. Swaps to 'Gravity Plus' for 1 turn. Stackable. Invisible.

abilities.name: Gravity Plus
abilities.description: Every enemy marked by 'Zero Gravity' takes 20 damage and has the cost of their skills increased by 1 random energy until they use a new skill (stacks).

abilities.name: Zero Gravity: Comet Shower
abilities.description: Grants all enemies a stack of 'Zero Gravity'. Swaps to 'Gravity Plus' for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Uraraka Float
abilities.description: For 2 turns, Uraraka gains 20 points of Shield and any enemy that uses a new skill on her will have 'Zero Gravity' used on them. During this time, this skill is replaced by 'Gravity Plus'. Invisible.

abilities.name: Spirit Particle Subjugation
abilities.description: Uryuu gains 4 Quincy Energy. As long as he has Quincy Energy remaining, this skill will be replaced by 'Quincy Final Kojaku Shot'.

abilities.name: Kojaku Shot
abilities.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy that ignores invulnerability. For 1 turn, 'Seele Schneider' costs 1 random energy and Uryuu becomes invulnerable to enemy non-strategic skills. Uses 1 Quincy Energy.

abilities.name: Seele Schneider
abilities.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 random energy from them. For 1 turn, 'Quincy Final Kojaku Shot' costs 1 blue 1 random energy. Uses 1 Quincy Energy.

abilities.name: Uryuu Evasion
abilities.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Quincy Final Kojaku Shot
abilities.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each Quincy Energy Uryuu has. This skill uses up all Quincy Energy. Bypasses.

abilities.name: Smoke Star
abilities.description: Usopp Blinds target enemy for 3 turns, and a different random enemy for 1 turn. Will not randomly target an enemy already affected by Smoke Star. Bypassing.

abilities.name: Impact Dial
abilities.description: For 1 turn, if any enemy uses a new skill on Usopp or target ally, they will be countered and Stunned for 1 turn if they are currently Blinded.

abilities.name: Lead Star
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, then deals 10 damage to all Blinded enemies.

abilities.name: Gunpowder Star
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. Enemies currently affected by Smoke Star take 5 more damage for each turn left on its duration. This ends Smoke Star on all affected targets, and any damaged enemy will have Smoke Star permanently last one more turn against them.

abilities.name: Sharpshooter
abilities.description: Passive: Usopp's attacks cannot Miss or be Dodged, and he ignores Blind effects.

abilities.name: Ki Blast
abilities.description: Deals 5 piercing damage to one enemy and reduces their non-Affliction damage equal to this skill's damage for 1 turn. Gains 5 more damage each turn that Vegeta does not use a damaging skill that resets on this skill's next use (stacks).

abilities.name: Double Ki Blast
abilities.description: Vegeta gains one stack of Ki Blast, then uses Ki Blast on the enemy team.

abilities.name: Galick Gun
abilities.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill deals 5 additional damage every time it's used. Uncounterable.

abilities.name: Energy Charge
abilities.description: Vegeta gains 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn. If he doesn't have a new Harmful skill used on him during this time, he reduces the cost of Galick Gun by 1 Red energy until the next time it's used (stacks).

abilities.name: Scoppio d'Ira
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Received a stun effect -> Stuns the targeted enemy for 1 turn. Received Piercing damage -> Deals Piercing damage. Received Affliction damage -> Applies 5 permanent Affliction damage.

abilities.name: Martello di Fiamma
abilities.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. This skill gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Been Countered -> Uncounterable. Been reduced below half health -> Deals 20 damage to other enemy targets.

abilities.name: Flames of Wrath
abilities.description: For 1 turn, Xanxus can trigger Scars of Wrath as though it had not yet been triggered by any effects this game. Invisible.

abilities.name: Sky Flame Deflection
abilities.description: Makes Xanxus invulnerable for 1 turn. This gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Received Affliction damage -> Heals Xanxus 15 health. Received a Shatter effect -> Gives Xanxus 25 Shield. Received an Isolate effect -> Fully cleanses Xanxus.

abilities.name: Scars of Wrath
abilities.description: Passive: The first time Xanxus receives normal damage, Scoppio d'Ira permanently deals 5 more damage, Martello di Flamma costs 1 less Random energy, and Sky Flame Deflection has 1 less cooldown. The same is true for receiving Piercing damage, receiving Affliction damage, being stunned, being countered, being shattered, being isolated, and being reduced below half health.

abilities.name: Shinotsuku Ame
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy, and lowers their damage by 10 for 2 turns (refreshes). Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu.

abilities.name: Utsuhi Ame
abilities.description: Targets one enemy invisibly for 1 turn. The following turn they take 15 damage that Bypasses Invulnerability and Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu. If the target used a skill this turn, they receive 15 additional damage and Yamamoto gains 2 stacks of Asari Ugetsu instead.

abilities.name: Asari Ugetsu
abilities.description: Consumes all stacks of Asari Ugetsu on use, and remains active for one turn plus one per stack consumed. While active, replaces Shinotsuku Ame with Scontro di Rondine and Utsuhi Ame with Beccata di Rondine, and Yamamoto gains 25 Shield.

abilities.name: Sakamaku Ame
abilities.description: Yamamoto becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Scontro di Rondine
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each damage reducing effect on them.

abilities.name: Beccata di Rondine
abilities.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team and lowers their damage by 5 for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Wind Blades Shower
