abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to the enemy affected by Gibbet and increases the cost of their skills by 1 Random energy. If the target has 35 or less HP, this skill is replaced by Guillotine.

abilities.name: Guillotine
abilities.description: Executes the enemy affected by Gibbet if their HP is 35 or less.

abilities.name: Texas Smash
abilities.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy. All Might takes 15 Affliction damage.

abilities.name: United Resolve
abilities.description: For 1 turn, All Might ignores Harmful non-damage effects and is Immortal. If All Might is under 40 HP, his skills deal 10 more damage on the following turn, increased to 20 if he received new damage during this time.

abilities.name: United States of Smash
abilities.description: Deals 60 Piercing damage to target enemy. All Might takes 25 Affliction damage.

abilities.name: Declare Successor
abilities.description: One of All Might's allies permanently gains One For All, and All Might permanently receives 10 more Affliction damage from his own skills. This skill can only be used once.

abilities.name: One For All
abilities.description: The affected ally has their Random costs reduced by 1 and whenever they use a new skill, they receive 10 Affliction damage. If All Might is dead, their colored costs are permanently changed to Random costs.

abilities.name: Black Wing
abilities.description: Deals 25 Affliction damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: Devil Slap
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Darkness Spear
abilities.description: Targets 1 enemy and gives them 10 Nullify, decreases non-Affliction damage they deal by 10 for 1 turn, and gives them two stacks of Lady's Poison.

abilities.name: Darkness Wave
abilities.description: LadyDevimon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Lady's Poison
abilities.description: Enemies that target LadyDevimon with Harmful skills take 5 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game (stacks)

abilities.name: AlphaBlast
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Shatters them for 2 turns (refreshes).

abilities.name: Blade of the Dragon King
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. Any time Damage Reduction, Shield, Nullify, or hostile damage mods affect this skill's damage, it permanently deals more damage proportional to the mitigated damage.

abilities.name: Digitalize of Soul
abilities.description: Permamently gives Alphamon 40 Shield and all enemies 20 Nullify. Each turn an enemy has Nullify from this skill remaining, Alphamon deals 20 damage to them. Each turn Alphamon has Shield from this skill remaining, he deals 10 damage to all enemies.

abilities.name: inForce Avoidance
abilities.description: Alphamon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Alpha inForce
abilities.description: If Alphamon's skills are countered, he regains the energy spent on them and heals 15 HP.

abilities.name: Toon Assault
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy for 2 turns (Bypasses).

abilities.name: Relinquished
abilities.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they will be countered and Pegasus will gain 30 Shield. As long as Pegasus has this Shield, this skill and the countered skill are unusable.

abilities.name: Dark-Eyes Illusionist
abilities.description: Marks target enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). If that enemy does not use a new skill during this time, they take 25 damage. If this effect is triggered while Pegasus has Shield from Relinquished, Relinquished will be permanently replaced by Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

abilities.name: Millennium Eye
abilities.description: Pegasus becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
abilities.description: Target enemy's Harmful skills are stunned for 4 turns and Pegasus gains 40 Shield. If this skill's Shield is destroyed, this effect will end and this skill will be replaced by Relinquished. Cannot be used while active.

abilities.name: Imitation Kamehameha
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. If Veldora hs 3 or more stacks of Slumbering Dragon, this skill stuns its target for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Explosive Aura
abilities.description: Deals 5 damage to all enemies and reduces their non-Affliction damage by 5 for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will cost 1 Random energy.

abilities.name: Tempest Fist
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If Veldora has 3 or more stacks of Slumbering Dragon, this skill targets all enemies.

abilities.name: Tempest Guard
abilities.description: Veldora becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Slumbering Dragon
abilities.description: Each turn, if Veldora doesn't use a new skill, he heals 5 HP and his next Harmful skill deals 5 more damage (stacks).

abilities.name: Fairy Law
abilities.description: Mavis channels for 3 turns. At the end of the 3rd turn, all enemies that are not Invulnerable take 35 damage and are stunned for 1 turn. All allies that are not Isolated heal 25 HP.

abilities.name: Bestow
abilities.description: Target ally has their first skill replaced by Fairy Glitter for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Fairy Sphere
abilities.description: Mavis's team ignores all damage for 1 turn, ignores Harmful non-damage effects for 2 turns, and gains 25 Shield for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Fairy Heart
abilities.description: Mavis becomes Invulnerable for 3 turns. During this team, she cannot act and she gains 1 Random energy each turn. This skill can only be used if Mavis has targetable allies, and while it is active she cannot be targeted by Fairy Star Strategy.

abilities.name: Fairy Star Strategy
abilities.description: At the start of each turn, a random ally is marked with Fairy Star Strategy. If they use a new skill, Mavis gains 1 stack and that ally gains a beneficial effect corresponding to the number of stacks Mavis now has: 1 - Gains 10 Shield. 2 - Heals 20 HP. 3 - Permanently deals 10 more non-Affliction damage. 4+ - Skills have no cost on the following turn.

abilities.name: Fairy Glitter
abilities.description: Deals 40 True damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: Crow Clone
abilities.description: Itachi targets one enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). During this time, if that enemy uses a new skill, Itachi's skills will cost 1 less Random energy for 1 turn. If they target Itachi with that skill, his skills will also cost 1 less White energy for 1 turn. If either effect is triggered, the enemy takes 10 Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Tsukuyomi
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and stuns them for 1 turn. If that enemy was countered by Kotoamatsukami or damaged by Crow Clone last turn, they are instead banished for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Kotoamatsukami
abilities.description: Itachi targets an enemy or an ally for 1 turn. If an ally, counters the next Harmful skill used on them. If an enemy, counters the next Harmful skill they use. The target of this skill is invisible.

abilities.name: Susanoo
abilities.description: After being used, the first time Itachi's HP is brought below 50, this effect will be triggered (Invisible). Once triggered, Itachi's other skills are permanently replaced by their alternate versions. During this time, he gains 50 Shield, permanently ignores non-damage effects, and takes 10 Affliction damage at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Totsuka Blade
abilities.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy cannot use skills (this is not a stun effect).

abilities.name: Yata Mirror
abilities.description: Itachi or target ally gains 30 Shield for 1 turn (Invisible). Each time they receive a Harmful skill during this time, he gains 1 Red energy.

abilities.name: Yasaka Magatama
abilities.description: Deals 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. If that enemy's skills are currently sealed by Totsuka Blade, this skill deals 20 more damage.

abilities.name: Death Chaser
abilities.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy is marked and this skill swaps to Sadistic Tread.

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 3 turns. Each turn, this damage increases by 10.

abilities.name: Darkness Eye Laser
abilities.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypassing). After damage, caps the target's HP at its current value.

abilities.name: Nova Chariot
abilities.description: For 1 turn, Cooler gains 25 Damage Reduction (Invisible). If he receives a new Harmful skill during this time, Death Chaser will deal 10 more damage to that skill's user on the following turn. Usable while Stunned.

abilities.name: Sadistic Tread
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to an enemy marked by Death Chaser and stuns them for 1 turn. Refreshes the duration of the mark and Sadistic Tread's swap effect.

abilities.name: Cruel Transformation
abilities.description: Whenever Death Chaser damages a Stunned enemy or drops a target to below 50 HP, or Nova Chariot is successfully triggered, Cooler enters his Final Form for 1 turn. While in this Form, Death Chaser costs 1 less Random energy, Supernova deals its damage instantly, and Cooler cannot be stunned.

abilities.name: Ashisogi Jizo
abilities.description: Target enemy takes 15 Affliction damage, then 5 Affliction damage for 2 turns. This effect stacks and refreshes, and if it reaches 3 stacks, it becomes permanent.

abilities.name: Data Collection
abilities.description: For 3 turns, all invisible skills and effects are revealed. During this time, Mayuri's Drug skills are empowered and he gains 1 Random energy each turn.

abilities.name: Flesh-Healing Drug
abilities.description: Target ally gains 10 Damage Reduction for 3 turns. During this time, they heal 10 HP each turn. While Empowered, this healing happens instantly. Will swap to a random Drug skill each turn.

abilities.name: Nikushibuki
abilities.description: Permanently, the next time Mayuri would be killed, he is instead Banished for 2 turns and returns at 30 HP. This effect can only trigger once, and after it has, this skill will make him Invulnerable for 1 turn instead.

abilities.name: Bankai - Konjiki Ashisogi Jizo
abilities.description: Once Mayuri uses 5 skills, he releases his Bankai for 4 turns. During this time, all enemies receive 5 more damage from Affliction skills and effects, and enemy that targets him with a non-Mental skill will take 5 Affliction damage for 2 turns. During this time, Ashisogi Jizo is replaced by Deadly Gas.

abilities.name: Deadly Gas
abilities.description: All enemies take 5 Affliction damage for 4 turns. During this time, they ignore cleansing and healing effects.

abilities.name: Superhuman Drug
abilities.description: For 1 turn, target enemy's skills are Delayed by 1 turn. While Empowered, the duration and delay amount are increased to 2 turns. Will swap to a random Drug skill each turn.

abilities.name: Postcognition Drug
abilities.description: Target enemy has a random skill's active cooldown increased by 1, and then is Paralyzed for 2 turns. While Empowered, the active cooldown increase occurs 3 times. Will swap to a random Drug skill each turn.

abilities.name: Perfected Combat
abilities.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. Deals +5 damage per time Cell has transformed.

abilities.name: Inherited Solar Flare
abilities.description: Target enemy is Stunned and Shattered for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Absorption
abilities.description: Target enemy gains 25 Nullify and receives 15 Affliction damage per turn for 2 turns. If the target has 30 or less HP, they are also Stunned for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Cellular Regeneration
abilities.description: Cell heals 15 HP for 1 turn. This skill lasts an additional turn for each 15 HP Cell is missing.

abilities.name: Genetic Perfection
abilities.description: If an enemy dies under the effect of Absorption or fails to break its Nullify while it's active, Cell transforms. The first time this happens, Inherited Solar Flare is replaced by Rampant Energy Rain. The second time this happens, Rampant Energy Rain is replaced by Inherited Kamehameha and Absorption is replaced by Inherited Death Beam.

abilities.name: Rampant Energy Rain
abilities.description: Each turn, deals 10 damage to 3 random targets. Continues as long as Cell continues to Channel.

abilities.name: Inherited Kamehameha
abilities.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypasses).

abilities.name: Inherited Death Beam
abilities.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and Isolates them for 1 turn (Bypasses).

abilities.name: Bleeding Shot
abilities.description: Deals 15 Bleed damage to target enemy for 3 turns, decreasing by 5 each turn.

abilities.name: Close-Range Rifle
abilities.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each Bleed effect on them. If at least one enemy is Shattered by Wave Tracking, this skill has no cost.

abilities.name: Relentless Hunter
abilities.description: For the next 4 turns, Rakko is Invulnerable to Strategic skills and any time an enemy uses a new Strategic skill, Rakko will deal 5 Bleed damage to them for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Rakko Block
abilities.description: Rakko becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Wave Tracking
abilities.description: Any time an enemy is affected by a new Bleed effect, Rakko also Shatters them for the same duration.

abilities.name: Space Sword Blaster
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and gives the ally marked with Uranus Lip Rod 10 Shield for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Intercepting Strike
abilities.description: Targets an ally for 1 turn. If an enemy uses a Harmful skill on them during this time, that skill will be countered and the attacker takes 25 damage. Cooldown reduced to 1 turn if this targets the ally marked by Uranus Lip Rod.

abilities.name: World Shaking
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, affected enemies receive 5 more damage from the ally marked by Uranus Lip Rod.

abilities.name: Space Defense
abilities.description: Uranus or the ally marked by Uranus Lip Rod become Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Uranus Lip Rod
abilities.description: At the start of combat, the ally directly below Uranus is permanently marked with Uranus Lip Rod. While marked, that ally gains 10 Damage Reduction.

abilities.name: Cloud Tonfa
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: Alaudi's Handcuffs
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, Stunning and Isolating them for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Porcospino Nuvola
abilities.description: For 3 turns, all enemies take 5 Piercing damage. During this time, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill takes 10 Piercing damage, and Cloud Tonfa has no cooldown.

abilities.name: Hibari Block
abilities.description: Hibari becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Cloud Flames
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy uses an Invisible skill, Hibari deals 5 permanent Affliction damage to them (stacks).

abilities.name: Hell Breaker
abilities.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to target enemy and gives them 1 stack of 5 permanent Affliction damage. Gives 1 additional stack for each random energy this skill costs.

abilities.name: Photon Flash
abilities.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypasses). Affects another random target for each random energy this skill costs.

abilities.name: Android Assault
abilities.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and increases the cost of their skills by 1 Random energy. Lasts 1 more turn for each random energy this skill costs.

abilities.name: Barrier
abilities.description: Android 17 gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. Grants 10 more Shield and lasts 1 more turn for each random energy this skill costs.

abilities.name: Infinite Energy Cycling
abilities.description: Each time Android 17 uses a skill, he gains 1 Random energy and his skills permanently cost 1 more Random energy. If he uses a skill that costs 3 energy, all stacks of this effect are removed.

abilities.name: Gigantic Slam
abilities.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Eraser Cannon
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy for 3 turns. During this time, if they use a new Harmful skill, that skill will be countered, they will take 10 damage, and this skill will end.

abilities.name: Explosive Wave
abilities.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies and Shatters them for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Powered Shell Protect
abilities.description: Broly becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and heals 10 HP for each stack of Legendary Super Saiyan on him.

abilities.name: Legendary Super Saiyan
abilities.description: Each time Broly receives a new Harmful skill, he permanently deals 5 more damage. Once he has 4 or more, Explosive Wave is permanently replaced with Planet Geyser Wave.

abilities.name: Planet Geyser Wave
abilities.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to all enemies. After use, Broly loses all stacks of Legendary Super Saiyan.

abilities.name: Violet Flash
abilities.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Consumes any Shield from Plasmantle on Arthur and any Nullify from Nirvana on the target to increase its damage by the same amount.

abilities.name: Plasmantle
abilities.description: For 1 turn, if Arthur would be damaged by a Harmful skill, he instead gains Shield equal to the damage he would have taken (Invisible) for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Nirvana
abilities.description: Marks target enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). If that enemy would deal new damage, they instead gain Nullify equal to the damage they would have dealt for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Star Ring
abilities.description: Permanently, if Arthur's HP falls below 50, he will ignore damage for 1 turn and Violet Flash will change to Moon Splitting Violet Flash.

abilities.name: Moon Splitting Violet Flash
abilities.description: Deals 45 Affliction damage to target enemy and executes them if their HP falls below 20. After using this skill, Arthur dies.
